about-strip.heading: How it is made
About the workshop
Our story
about-strip.body: We started making one bag for ourselves because nothing on sale was repairable. The range grew slowly from there.
Everything is made in batches of forty or fewer, by four people, in a converted joinery.
If something breaks, send it back. We would rather repair it than sell you another.
